AUTHOR: Martins
TITLE: Temporal aggregation of vision-language features for high-accuracy fish classification in automated monitoring
REGION: Iceland: rivers Krossá, Laxá in Leirársveit, Selá (2018-2022)
SPECIES: Atlantic salmon, brown/sea trout, Arctic char (+ not-fish class for detection)
DATA: MFRI VAKI Riverwatcher fish-counter videos, 9257 expert-labelled videos; 3990 used for species classification
V_EV: Sec. 2.3: 'Videos may contain one or more fish recorded in clear water conditions, with occasional instances of artifacts (e.g., minor biofouling, algae, and heavy turbulence)'; colour by day, infrared at night
D2: Detection: 334/333 videos val/test; multi-fish: 5-fold CV by video; species: 80/20 train/test by video, 10 seeds, 5-fold CV within train
D_EV: Sec. 2.4: 'all dataset splits were performed at the video level... This video-level partitioning eliminates the temporal correlation between the training and evaluation sets.'
R_EV: Sec. 4.2.4: 'validation in controlled underwater environments with standardized lighting and camera positions may limit its generalization'; test splits drawn from the same counter dataset
C_EV: Sec. 3.1.3: 'The threshold found, by maximizing the F1-score at the frame-level, resulted in the optimal value of ≈0.978'
E_EV: Sec. 3.1.3/Table 4: only '99.1% accuracy, 100% precision, and 98.2% recall' and macro F1 for species classification
ARCH: Zero-shot SigLIP ViT-SO400M-14 (prompt ensembles) for fish/multi-fish detection; SigLIP embeddings + temporal pooling + SVM/LR for species; ResNet-50 baselines
METR: accuracy, precision, recall, F1, AUC, macro/weighted F1, confusion matrix, learning curves
NOTE: Fishway/river counter footage (field deployment) -> included. Pretraining on web image-text data (WebLI/LAION; no matching PRE option) -> PRE=NR. Zero-shot use of web-pretrained VLMs not treated as external test (no fish in-domain baseline); all test data from same counter network -> R1=N; verifier may judge otherwise. Fig. 9 shows correct/incorrect counts by confidence range (informal, not coded as calibration). Thresholds F1-optimised (0.978 detection, 0.962 multi-fish) -> C_ALL=P. Videos with short fish segments (16%) and multi-fish excluded.
